Smtp._comment: Leave Host empty to use console-simulation mode (mirrors the prior [MAIL SIMULATION] behavior). Fill these in with real SMTP credentials (e.g. via environment variables or a secrets store in production) to enable real email delivery — see SmtpEmailService.

Backup._comment: Database Backup & Restore module ('Dump File Mechanism'). MySqlDumpPath/MySqlRestorePath point at the MySQL client tools. If relative paths are used, they are resolved relative to the repository/project root. OutputDirectory is relative to the API content root.
